datasets.name: usage_kpis
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
  SELECT
    u.account_id,
    CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    u.usage_date,
    LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
    u.sku_name,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS active_users_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(total_dbus),2) AS total_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(free_dbus),2) AS free_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus_30d
 FROM usage_base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29)

    u.usage_date,
    LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
    u.sku_name,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
SELECT usage_date AS day,
 ROUND(SUM(total_dbus),2) AS total_dbus,

 FROM usage_base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)

datasets.name: product_usage
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
  SELECT
    u.account_id,
    CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    u.usage_date,
    LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
    u.sku_name,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
, products AS (
 SELECT 'GENIE_CODE' AS genie_product
 UNION ALL SELECT 'GENIE_ONE'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'GENIE_AGENTS'
), aggregates AS (
 SELECT genie_product,
 COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS active_users,
 ROUND(SUM(total_dbus),2) AS total_dbus,
 ROUND(SUM(free_dbus),2) AS free_dbus,
 ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus
 FROM usage_base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
 GROUP BY genie_product
)
SELECT p.genie_product,
 COALESCE(a.active_users,0) AS active_users,
 COALESCE(a.total_dbus,0D) AS total_dbus,
 COALESCE(a.free_dbus,0D) AS free_dbus,
 COALESCE(a.billed_dbus,0D) AS billed_dbus
FROM products p LEFT JOIN aggregates a ON p.genie_product=a.genie_product
ORDER BY total_dbus DESC

  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
SELECT user_identity,
 ROUND(SUM(total_dbus),2) AS total_dbus,

 FROM usage_base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
 GROUP BY user_identity
 ORDER BY billed_dbus DESC, total_dbus DESC LIMIT 30

datasets.name: usage_watchlist
queryLines:
WITH usage_base AS (
  SELECT
    u.account_id,
    CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    u.usage_date,
    LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
    u.sku_name,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
, windowed AS (
 SELECT user_identity,
 SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0D END) AS total_dbus_30d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0D END) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 6) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0D END) AS dbus_7d,
 SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),7) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0D END) AS dbus_prev_28d
 FROM usage_base
 WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34)
 GROUP BY user_identity
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY billed_dbus_30d DESC, total_dbus_30d DESC) AS usage_rank,
 CASE WHEN dbus_prev_28d > 0D THEN ROUND((dbus_7d/7D)/(dbus_prev_28d/28D),2) ELSE NULL END AS rate_ratio
 FROM windowed
 WHERE total_dbus_30d > 0D
)
SELECT user_identity,
 CASE WHEN usage_rank <= 10 THEN 'HIGH_CONSUMPTION'
      WHEN dbus_7d >= 15D AND COALESCE(rate_ratio,0D) >= 3D THEN 'RECENT_SPIKE'
      WHEN dbus_7d > 0D AND dbus_prev_28d = 0D THEN 'NEW_ACTIVITY'
      ELSE 'BASELINE' END AS review_type,
 ROUND(total_dbus_30d,2) AS total_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(billed_dbus_30d,2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(dbus_7d,2) AS last_7d_dbus,
 rate_ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY CASE WHEN usage_rank<=10 THEN 1
              WHEN dbus_7d>=15D AND COALESCE(rate_ratio,0D)>=3D THEN 2
              WHEN dbus_7d>0D AND dbus_prev_28d=0D THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
         billed_dbus_30d DESC,total_dbus_30d DESC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: cost_kpis
queryLines:
WITH matched AS (
 SELECT
   u.account_id,
   u.record_id,
   u.usage_date,
   LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
   COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
   u.sku_name,
   CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
        WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE)
   END AS estimated_usd,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.account_id, u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
   ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
  AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
  AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
  AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
  AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
), priced AS (SELECT * FROM matched WHERE rn = 1)
, summary AS (
 SELECT
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_paid_rows_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN estimated_usd ELSE 0D END) AS cost_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_paid_rows_mtd,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN estimated_usd ELSE 0D END) AS cost_mtd
 FROM priced
), user_cost AS (
 SELECT user_identity, SUM(estimated_usd) AS cost_usd
 FROM priced WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
 GROUP BY user_identity
), user_rank AS (
 SELECT cost_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
 FROM user_cost
), concentration AS (
 SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rnk <= 5 THEN cost_usd ELSE 0D END) AS cost_top5,
        SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_all
 FROM user_rank
)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN unpriced_paid_rows_30d>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(cost_30d,2) END AS estimated_cost_usd_30d,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_paid_rows_mtd>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(cost_mtd * DAY(LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())) / GREATEST(DAY(CURRENT_DATE()),1),2) END AS projected_month_end_usd,
 CASE WHEN unpriced_paid_rows_30d>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100D*cost_top5/NULLIF(cost_all,0D),1) END AS top5_cost_share_pct,
 unpriced_paid_rows_30d
FROM summary CROSS JOIN concentration

datasets.name: cost_by_user
queryLines:
WITH matched AS (
 SELECT
   u.account_id,
   u.record_id,
   u.usage_date,
   LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
   COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
   u.sku_name,
   CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
        WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE)
   END AS estimated_usd,
   CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.account_id, u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
   ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
  AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
  AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
  AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
  AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
), priced AS (SELECT * FROM matched WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT user_identity,
 ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus,
 CASE WHEN SUM(missing_price)>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(estimated_usd),2) END AS estimated_cost_usd,
 SUM(missing_price) AS unpriced_paid_rows
FROM priced
WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
GROUP BY user_identity
ORDER BY billed_dbus DESC, estimated_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

Activity includes Genie Code, Genie One and Genie Agents. Free usage may have zero estimated USD. SQL warehouse cost is excluded.
